plan: Deep-copy and validate the workspace tree, including unique identifiers and item-specific fields.
Use recursive traversal for word aggregation, marker collection, and deterministic outline rendering.
Implement moves with complete preflight validation so invalid containment or indices cannot mutate state.

trace.target_mechanism: A shared recursive tree walk applies aggregation and collection uniformly to items at every section/group depth.
Depth-first traversal in stored list order renders the indented outline deterministically.
Move preflight resolves both locations, validates destination type, cycle safety, and index bounds before removing the source item.
